description: Manages npm, Python, pre-commit, development environments, Gradle dependencies and Wrapper, Node versions, Dockerfiles, and GitHub Actions in workflows and composite actions. Dependabot only supplies the security alerts behind the vulnerabilityAlerts PRs; its own update PRs are turned off.

An open PR changes only inside its schedule (updateNotScheduled) and is rebased only when it conflicts (rebaseWhen). By default Renovate pushed the grouped PR again for every release of a grouped dependency and after master moved, and each push runs every platform pipeline. The vulnerabilityAlerts PR is always in schedule. To update a PR sooner, tick the rebase checkbox in its description

customManagers.description: Docker variant base images; docker-compose.yml is generated from variants.json and test_plan_docker_builds.py pins the same build args, so all three update together. ignorePaths must stay set: without it config:recommended skips **/tests/**

The uv required-version floor, which tools/validate_configs.py requires to match the uv image tag in the builder and fuzzing Dockerfiles. It follows uv's PyPI releases, not the image: Renovate passes every dependency updated in pyproject.toml to `uv lock --upgrade-package`, which rejects an image name and fails the lock file update

The CMake that build-setup installs with lukka/get-cmake, which resolves versions from a catalog bundled in each of its releases. Its tags name the newest CMake in that catalog, so following them keeps the pin installable; the github-actions manager bumps the action in the same group PR
The Ninja that build-setup installs with lukka/get-cmake
Prebuilt CI tools in build-config.json's tools section (ccache, mold, sccache, Grype, Packer, RunsOn CLI, ClangBuildAnalyzer), tracked by their GitHub releases
The OpenSSL release that cmake/modules/AndroidOpenSSL.cmake builds for Android, tracked by OpenSSL's openssl-X.Y.Z GitHub releases
AppImage packaging tools in build-config.json's appimage section (linuxdeploy, appimagetool, appimagelint), tracked by their GitHub release tags

C++ libraries that CPMAddPackage fetches from GitHub at a version tag. The patterns cover each field order in use: VERSION before the repository, VERSION after it, a tag alone (v, vulkan-sdk- or expat's R_ form), and a version variable set just above the call. VERSION and GIT_TAG repeat the version, so both are rewritten. A package pinned to a commit, or to a tag that is not a version, does not match: tools/tests/ci/contracts/test_renovate_cpm_pins.py lists every package left untracked. ArduPilot's parameter repository commit has its own manager below, and no package tracks a branch head

ArduPilot's parameter metadata, which qgc_git_sparse_checkout fetches at a commit of the main branch: ArduPilot regenerates it there every few days and tags no releases, so the pin follows the branch head

packageRules.description: Combine every update except Android into one weekly PR, so coupled pins such as the uv required-version floor and the Dockerfile's uv image land together
Group Android library updates such as usb-serial-for-android; the Qt-coupled Android toolchain has its own group below
Keep lock file maintenance in one PR instead of one per group

Qt's Android template pins the Android Gradle Plugin, Gradle, and androidx.core for each Qt release, and the Kotlin Gradle plugin must support them. A newer release can need a compileSdk or Android Gradle Plugin newer than that Qt supports, which breaks androidx and other libraries, so these wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard and move together with Qt upgrades, following Qt's template
lukka/get-cmake picks up new Ninja releases only when it next refreshes its bundled catalog
A tools pin bump also needs the release's SHA-256 digests in build-config.json (mold and ClangBuildAnalyzer publish none), so each opens its own PR only after approval on the Dependency Dashboard
The Android OpenSSL and AppImage tool pins also carry SHA-256 digests in build-config.json, which a bump must update by hand, so each opens its own PR only after approval on the Dependency Dashboard
Android builds stay on OpenSSL 3.5, the long-term support series maintained until April 2030; widen this to move to a later series
linuxdeploy tags its releases 1-alpha-YYYYMMDD-N, and its rolling continuous release is not a version
appimagelint publishes only its rolling continuous release, which has no version to follow; build-config.json pins that build's digest instead

Each Ubuntu builder variant is named for its release, so its base image takes digest updates only. The regex manager lacks the dockerfile manager's Ubuntu versioning and would offer 22.10 as a minor update of 22.04

tools/pyproject.toml pins aqtinstall to the head of miurahr/aqtinstall#1048 for Qt 6.12; Renovate would move the pin to the default branch, which lacks that change. Updates resume once aqtinstall returns to PyPI
Adopt a GitHub Actions release only after 7 days, so a compromised release can be withdrawn first. The CMake pin follows lukka/get-cmake's tags and must move with that action

Pin every action and reusable workflow outside actions/* and github/* to a commit SHA, with its version in a trailing comment that Renovate updates together with the SHA: whoever controls an action's repository can move a tag, which the release cooldown above does not notice. GitHub's own actions stay on version tags. zizmor's unpinned-uses policy and tools/tests/ci/contracts/test_workflow_security_policy.py enforce the same split
Runner images and job containers in workflows are platform choices, not routine updates
The CPM libraries ship in the application, so each update is reviewed on its own: no grouping, and a PR only after approval on the Dependency Dashboard
ArduPilot's parameter metadata needs no approval: before it was pinned every build fetched the head of main, so each new commit arrives as its own scheduled PR
SDL tags its releases release-X.Y.Z
Clipper2 tags its releases Clipper2_X.Y.Z
GeographicLib tags its releases rX.Y
Vulkan-Headers is pinned to its four-part vulkan-sdk-X.Y.Z.N tags, not its vX.Y.Z tags
Expat tags its releases R_X_Y_Z, and the whole tag is the pinned value

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: One PR for every security fix, major or not, so packages that constrain each other resolve together. It takes the newest fixed version, because the lowest one can carry a later advisory
